svg.title: Contractum component integration map
svg.desc: People (in a browser or a CLI) and pipelines reach the Traefik gateway over HTTPS. The gateway serves the web UI from the ui container at / and routes /api/v1/<module>/ to the identity, contracts, validation and audit services. Every service asks identity for authorization decisions. Each service has its own PostgreSQL database; identity, contracts and validation relay outbox rows to NATS JetStream, which the audit service consumes. contracts calls validation before publishing and sends email through the mail service. Dev-only stand-ins are drawn with dashed grey borders.
svg.text: Entra or local JWT, or a PAT
Traefik gateway — the only published port (host 8443 → 443)
TLS · CORS · strips identity headers · 2 MiB body limit · rate limits · routes by /api/v1/<module>/ · no authentication
stream AUDIT, subjects audit.> (change and denial events, guaranteed)
stream ACCESS, subjects access.> (read events, best effort)
Each box is a container in compose.yaml. Solid arrow = synchronous HTTP call. Dashed arrow = asynchronous event through NATS.
JWKS (every service) · Graph group lookups (identity) — HTTP
asynchronous event (NATS); from a DB = outbox relay
dev-only stand-in (compose only, never in production)
